=== Enshrined deity ===
* Enshrined deity: Kamuatakaashitsuhime-no-Mikoto ({{ill|Konohanasakuya-hime|az|Konohanasakuya|ca|Konohana no Sakuya hime|de|Konohanasakuyahime|fa|کونوهاناساکویا-هیمه|fr|Konohana-no-Sakuya|it|Konohanasakuya-hime|ja|コノハナノサクヤビメ|ko|고노하나노사쿠야비메|mni|ꯀꯣꯅꯣꯍꯅꯁꯀꯨꯌ-ꯍꯤꯃꯦ|pl|Konohanasakuya-hime|ru|Коноханасакуя-химэ|sv|Konohanasakuyahime|th|เซ็นเง็ง|vi|Konohana Sakuya Hime|zh|木花開耶姬|qid=Q1781862}})

=== History ===
In the {{ill|Tenpyō|br|Tenpyō|ca|Era Tenpyō|de|Tempyō|es|Tenpyō|fa|تنپیو|fr|Ère Tenpyō|ia|Tenpyo|id|Tempyō|it|Tenpyō|ja|天平|ko|덴표|no|Tenpyō|pt|Tenpyō|ru|Тэмпё|simple|Tenpyō|sr|Тенпјо|tr|Tenpyō|uk|Темпьо (ненґо)|zh|天平 (日本)|zh_yue|天平 (日本)|qid=Q1199879}} period, provincial guardian Someya Tarō Tokitada is said to have invited the deity praying for stability of the land and children. It was famed for efficacy in safe childbirth prayers. Later it became an imperial-prayer site of {{ill|Emperor Daigo|ar|الإمبراطور دايغو|arz|امبيرور دايجو|azb|دایقو (ایمپیراتور)|ca|Daigo|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر دایگۆ|cs|Daigo|de|Daigo|el|Αυτοκράτορας Νταϊγκό|eo|Daigo (imperiestro)|es|Daigo Tennō|fa|امپراتور دایگو|fr|Daigo|id|Kaisar Daigo|it|Daigo|ja|醍醐天皇|ko|다이고 천황|ms|Maharaja Daigo|nl|Daigo (keizer)|pl|Daigo|pt|Daigo|ru|Император Дайго|sh|Car Daigo|sl|Cesar Daigo|sv|Daigo (kejsare)|sw|Daigo wa Japani|th|จักรพรรดิไดโงะ|tl|Emperador Daigo|tr|Daigo (imparator)|uk|Імператор Дайґо|ur|شہنشاہ ڈائیگو|vi|Thiên hoàng Daigo|yo|Emperor Daigo|zh|醍醐天皇|zh_min_nan|Daigo Thian-hông|zh_yue|醍醐天皇|qid=Q329753}}, but divine ranks, oracle documents, and old records were lost at the fall of Odawara in {{ill|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|Q1145058|qid=Q1145058}} 18 ({{ill|1590|Q6764|qid=Q6764}}). After that it was called "Easy-Delivery Daimyōjin" or "Koyasu Daimyōjin" and revered as a guardian deity of safe childbirth.

The other candidate shrine for the Shikinaisha Hibita Shrine is {{ill|Hibita Shrine|Q11547364|qid=Q11547364}} in Sannomiya, same city. Its tradition tells that an old plaque reading "Hibita Shrine" was once lent to the priest of Koyasu Myōjin Shrine and not returned, and then displayed there to claim Shikinaisha status{{sfn|新編相模国風土記稿 三ノ宮村 三宮明神社}}. There is no evidence for this story.

Pillars of the haiden have become thinner because worshippers formerly shaved off small pieces as safe-birth charms (now prohibited).

=== Festivals ===
* January 1: {{ill|Saitan-sai|Q11546824|qid=Q11546824}} (New Year festival)
* Sunday after start of spring in February: {{ill|Kinensai|Q118906710|qid=Q118906710}} (spring festival)
* First horse day of early February: {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Hatsuuma festival}}
* July 15: '''{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Grand Annual Festival}}'''
* November 23: {{ill|Niiname-no-Matsuri|Q11501518|qid=Q11501518}}
* December 31: {{ill|Chinese New Year's Eve|Q7245702|qid=Q7245702}} festival
* Monthly on 1st and 15th: monthly rite

=== Shrine-held items / cultural assets ===
* Beauty painting - by {{ill|Kunitsune Utagawa|Q33319365|qid=Q33319365}}, dedicated in {{ill|Kyōwa|Q960763|qid=Q960763}} 2 ({{ill|1802|Q6883|qid=Q6883}}), 12th month
* Ema - designated prefectural {{ill|Important Cultural Property (Japan)|Q1188622|qid=Q1188622}} dated Nov 4, {{ill|1962|Q2764|qid=Q2764}} ({{ill|Shōwa era|Q327567|qid=Q327567}} 35){{sfn|伊勢原の指定文化財}}
* {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Nagi}} tree - city-designated preserved tree (one nagi leaf is placed in this shrine's skin-protection charm)

=== Access ===
*From north exit of {{ill|Isehara Station|Q4205219|qid=Q4205219}} on {{ill|Odakyū Odawara Line|Q135176|qid=Q135176}} ({{ill|Odakyu Electric Railway|Q83584|qid=Q83584}}), take {{ill|Kanagawa Chuo Kotsu|Q10854960|qid=Q10854960}} bus ({{ill|route I10|Q11588882|qid=Q11588882|lt=route I10}}) toward {{ill|Ōyama Cable Car|Q864604|qid=Q864604}}, get off at "Myōjin-mae," 1 minute walk.
